vectors.precondition: A valid product-scoped wallet challenge is issued for YNX Monitor on ynx_6423-1 / 6423.
vectors.action: Submit the centrally verified signed challenge twice.
expected: First submission creates a short Monitor session bound to the authorized role.
Second submission fails with challenge_invalid_expired_or_replayed.
No broader scope or alternate product session is issued.

vectors.precondition: An authenticated Monitor session has a server-issued csrfToken and the deployment has an exact operator-origin allowlist.
vectors.action: Submit an authenticated mutation with no Origin, an untrusted Origin, no CSRF token, an invalid CSRF token, and then the exact trusted Origin plus the session-bound token.
expected: Missing Origin fails with origin_required.
A non-allowlisted Origin fails with origin_not_allowed.
Missing or invalid session-bound CSRF evidence fails with csrf_token_required or csrf_token_invalid.
Only the trusted Origin plus the token bound to the presented session reaches role and explicit-approval checks.

vectors.precondition: incident_commander, backup_recovery, and security_reviewer sessions exist.
vectors.action: Attempt incident creation/management/recovery verification/postmortem, backup recording, alert acknowledgement, and rollback proposal from every scoped role.
expected: incident_commander can create/manage incidents, complete postmortems, and acknowledge alerts, but cannot verify recovery.
backup_recovery can independently verify recovery, record backup evidence, and propose rollback, but cannot manage or close the postmortem.
security_reviewer can acknowledge alerts and independently verify backup, restore, and rollback evidence, but cannot create those records.
All cross-domain actions fail with permission_required.

vectors.precondition: A critical incident is open with direct source evidence and scoped Incident Commander and Backup/Recovery sessions.
vectors.action: Attempt a skipped transition, then progress through assignment, acknowledgement, investigation, mitigation, recovery verification, resolution, postmortem, restart, and evidence export.
expected: Skipped or out-of-order transitions fail with invalid_incident_transition and preserve state.
Repeated target-state actions are idempotent and do not duplicate audit or timeline entries.
Incident Commander cannot self-verify recovery.
Backup/Recovery cannot verify recovery without direct evidence.
Postmortem cannot complete before recovery is independently verified.
The lifecycle survives restart inside the integrity-protected state envelope.
Authenticated export returns ynx.monitor.incident-export.v1 with the complete timeline and postmortem.

vectors.precondition: A version-2 Monitor state envelope has been persisted.
vectors.action: Modify persisted state without recomputing its integrity digest and restart Monitor.
expected: Startup fails closed with monitor state integrity check failed.
No tampered incident, alert, backup, rollback, or audit record is loaded.

vectors.precondition: Chain telemetry adapter has a previously healthy observation.
vectors.action: Make finality or validator telemetry unavailable beyond its accepted freshness window.
expected: Monitor marks the dependency unavailable or stale, never healthy.
The prior value is not presented as current.
A source-labelled alert and evidence reference are persisted.

vectors.precondition: Oracle reports source, version, asOf, confidence, stale, and divergence state.
vectors.action: Inject stale or divergent market-data status.
expected: Monitor preserves the Oracle owner state and does not recompute price truth.
A stale or divergence alert is raised with the original source metadata.
No healthy status is inferred from HTTP success alone.

vectors.precondition: A bounded Testnet strategy has an active mandate and risk telemetry.
vectors.action: Trigger a daily-loss or drawdown breach and execute the owner-approved kill switch.
expected: Monitor observes the risk breach, kill request, execution result, mandate state, and reconciliation result.
Monitor cannot change the mandate, resume the strategy, or move assets.
Resume requires a new owner review.

vectors.precondition: A backup artifact, hash, retention class, RPO, and RTO are registered.
vectors.action: Restore into an isolated environment and verify application state and integrity.
expected: Restore result records artifact hash, independent verifier, start/end, observed RPO/RTO, integrity/application checks, and failure details.
A successful verification requires a previously verified backup plus direct review evidence.
Monitor records evidence only and does not claim or execute a backup or restore.
Malformed, premature, incomplete, and same-actor verification attempts fail closed.

vectors.precondition: Candidate and previous release manifests are available.
vectors.action: Submit an explicitly approved rollback proposal from backup_recovery.
expected: Monitor stores approved-not-executed with candidate, previous release, reason, and dry-run evidence.
A different Security Reviewer must independently verify the proposal before it becomes verified-not-executed.
Missing manifests, dry-run evidence, review evidence, or same-actor verification fail closed.
No infrastructure command is executed by Monitor; execution remains with the central infrastructure owner.

vectors.precondition: Private OpsStore state contains usernames, topology paths, audit details, backup references, stack-like data, and internal errors while a separately signed public snapshot exists.
vectors.action: Read /status for a valid approved snapshot, then submit signed snapshots with unknown fields, private text, fake healthy aggregation, stale data, wrong approval role, provider failure, and oversized or symbolic-link file sources.
expected: Valid output contains only the strict public schema, approved public services/incidents, source, version, asOf, and publishedAt.
No private OpsStore actor, path, evidence, topology, audit, backup, restore, rollback, stack, approval ID, approval role, or HMAC field is exposed.
Unknown fields, private text, fake healthy aggregation, stale data, wrong approval, invalid files, and provider errors return bounded 503 responses without echoing source content.

vectors.precondition: The deployment pins an approved publisher ID and an independent public-status integrity key.
vectors.action: Submit unsigned, post-signature-tampered, wrong-publisher, and older previously valid snapshots after a newer snapshot has been accepted.
expected: Unsigned or tampered snapshots fail with public_status_integrity_invalid.
A correctly signed snapshot from another publisher fails with public_status_source_mismatch.
An older signed snapshot after a newer accepted snapshot fails with public_status_replayed.
No rejected source content is reflected in the response.
